steps.message: Since I'm running this from PowerShell, I will quote the complete binary-log switch so the literal braces reach MSBuild: dotnet build SimpleApp.csproj "-bl:{}". Doubling the braces would be incorrect because MSBuild would retain them in the generated filename.

results.content: Ran (PowerShell): dotnet build SimpleApp.csproj "-bl:{}" -> Build succeeded. A new *.binlog file was written to the working directory with an auto-generated unique name.

steps.message: Build succeeded and produced a binlog. Quoting the complete "-bl:{}" switch protected the single {} placeholder from PowerShell parsing so the literal braces reached MSBuild. I did not double the braces or fall back to bare -bl, which would overwrite msbuild.binlog on every run.
